newsitem.title: TURKEY: TURKISH SHARES DOWN 1.36 PCT AS WORRIES PERSIST.
newsitem.headline: TURKISH SHARES DOWN 1.36 PCT AS WORRIES PERSIST.

text.p: Istanbul shares lost an average 1.36 percent in thin trade on Monday morning as concerns over the future of Turkey's Islamist-led coalition government persisted, brokers said.
The IMKB National-100 .XU100 ended at 1,446, down 20 points from Friday after moving between 1,437 and 1,478. It had dived 4.3 in two trading days last week.
Morning volume weakened to 5.15 trillion lira after 5.82 trillion on Friday.
